experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4773:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21691:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4774:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21692:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4775:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4776:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21694:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4778:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4779:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4780:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4782:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4783:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4784:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4785:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4786:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21704:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4787:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4788:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21706:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4789:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21707:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4790:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21708:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4791:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21709:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4792:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21710:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4796:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21714:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4797:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21715:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4798:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21716:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4799:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21717:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。

experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4807:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21725:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3901:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:20:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4808:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21726:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4809:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21727:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3903:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4810:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21728:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3904:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:23:(9) 对照隔离: lattice 生成复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py(byte-identical 降质), eval 复用 kill-switch.
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4811:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21729:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3905:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:24:也用 web search 查 lattice-marginalization / sub-pixel sampling uncertainty for low-res ReID 是否有 exact 先例。输出: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings (severity Critical/High/Medium/Low, 每条带行号+修法).
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4815:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21733:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4816:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21734:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4817:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21735:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4818:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21736:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4819:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21737:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4820:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21738:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4821:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21739:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4822:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21740:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4824:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21742:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:71:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4825:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21743:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4826:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21744:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4827:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21745:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4828:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21746:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4829:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21747:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4830:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21748:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4831:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21749:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4832:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21750:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/exp360_intruder/codex_h2fail_decision.md:4833:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21751:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5865:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5866:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5870:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5873:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5882:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5885:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5889:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5895:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5904:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5922:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5928:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5937:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5941:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5942:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5943:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5944:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5945:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/meta_converge.md:5949:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19266:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19267:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19271:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19274:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19283:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19286:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19290:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19296:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19305:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19323:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19329:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19338:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19342:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19343:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19344:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19345:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19346:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19350:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:19355:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20111:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20112:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20113:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20114:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20115:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20116:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20117:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20118:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20120:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20121:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20122:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20123:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20124:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20125:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20126:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20127:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20128:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20129:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20130:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20134:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20135:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20136:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20137:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20146:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20153:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20154:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20155:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20156:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20157:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20158:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20159:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20160:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20162:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3918:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:71:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20163:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20164:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3920:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:95:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20165:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3921:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:104:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20166:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20167:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20168:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3924:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:110:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20169:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20170:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3926:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:112:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20171:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20256:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4012:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2577:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20257:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4013:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2578:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20259:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4015:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2580:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20260:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4016:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20261:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4017:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2582:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20518:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:20532:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21691:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21692:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3868:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:4:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21693:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21694:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21695:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21696:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21697:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21698:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21700:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3876:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:42:L_adv  = GRL-CE(Dφ(z^l), lattice_label_l)                        # 弱：去掉 embedding 中可预测 lattice label
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21701:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21702:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3878:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21703:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3879:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:75:- 新指标：PRF@1（phase rank-flip rate）、Flip Entropy、LEG（lattice ensemble gain）、LOTG（lattice-over-TTA gain）、query ΔAP。按 h 分报 + paired bootstrap 95% CI + K=1/3/5/9 曲线 + compute cost。PRF 随 h（74.9%→31%→10%→1.2%）是强故事线。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21704:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21705:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21706:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21707:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21708:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3884:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:83:- FlipReID（2105.05639）：ReID 常用 flip-mean TTA → **必须反复强调非 TTA 换名**（同 K vs-TTA 控制，lattice 多 +3.04）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21709:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21710:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21714:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21715:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3891:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:9:- **单变量**：唯一变量 = "训练 lattice-invariance" vs "frozen 模型"。eval 复用 kill-switch（byte-identical degradation），与 frozen baseline 只差"是否 fine-tune"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21716:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21717:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3893:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:29:- lattice 生成函数（make_lr/make_lattice_variants/pil_to_tensor_np/_to_target_aspect）**逐行复制自 cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py** → 训练降质与 GO kill-switch eval **byte-identical**（单变量隔离的关键）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21718:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3894:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:43:逐行审查 + 源码接口验证完成，4 处问题已修（KL 方向 / AMP / 稳健 out 取值 / scaler backward）。代码正确、对照隔离干净（lattice 生成 byte-identical 复用、eval 复用 kill-switch）、过线判据明确、诚实判死路径清楚。**审查通过**，可进 smoke + 训练（仍需 Codex 独立审通过）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21720:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3896:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:8:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21724:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3900:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:17:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21726:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21733:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21734:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3910:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:33:> 设计来源：`experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt`（完整 codex 设计）+ `cvpb_lattice_result.md`（kill-switch 数据）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21735:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21736:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3912:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:40:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21737:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21738:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21739:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21740:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3916:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:62:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21835:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4011:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2576:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21836:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4012:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2577:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21837:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4013:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2578:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21839:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4015:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2580:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21840:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4016:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2581:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:66:- **frozen lattice ensemble**（零训练 K=9，= kill-switch 的 +4.23，这是训练版必须超过的硬线）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21841:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4017:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2582:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21853:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4029:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2966:web search: "lattice marginalization" person re-identification low resolution sub-pixel sampling
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21855:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4031:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2992:- **High** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:173): per-sample RNG is reset from `seed + idx`, so each image gets the same height and same lattice variants every epoch. This contradicts design “每图每 iter 采样 M variants”.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21857:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4033:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:2996:  Fix: make real training default `M>=4` at minimum, or sample perturbation mode/kernel for each noncanonical variant; if keeping `L_adv`, store actual lattice labels.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21859:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4035:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3001:- **Medium** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:345): `L_id` triplet is computed over flattened `B*M`, not `mean_l Triplet(gf[:, l], y)`. This treats other variants of the same image as positives and is not exactly the stated per-lattice-slot formula.
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21860:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4036:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3004:- **Low** [cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96](/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py:96): lattice generation appears output-equivalent to kill-switch, but not literally byte-identical source.  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21861:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4037:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3018:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21997:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4493:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1920:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:132:2. **vs-#false**：控制“多试几次总会撞上更好结果”的假象，可以用 shuffled lattice labels、非 lattice photometric variants、或 same-K random harmless variants。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21998:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4494:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1921:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:136:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:21999:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4495:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1923:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/lattice_method_design.txt:140:RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery，用 feature distillation/filtering 去掉 resolution-related feature。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871)) 它占了“resolution-invariant distillation”，但没有占 lattice intervention。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22098:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4594:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22099:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4595:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3870:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:11:frozen exp260b Market，K=9 lattice variants ensemble，HR gallery / LR query：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22100:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4596:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22101:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4597:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3874:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:33:2. fine-tune：HR train image 在线生成 LR lattice variants `x^l = U(D_l(x))`，l ∈ {sub-pixel phase, bbox jitter, downsample kernel}。每图每 iter 采样 M=2-4 variants，eval 用 K=9。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22103:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4599:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3882:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:81:- RFD（2109.07871）：multi-res gallery distillation，占"resolution-invariant distillation"，没占 lattice intervention。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22104:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4600:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3892:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:23:- **L_adv** = GRL：disc 预测 variant slot，梯度反转使 z 不含可预测 lattice label。`slot=arange(M).repeat(B)` 与 image-major reshape 对齐。warmup-gated（adv_start），默认 lam_adv=0（弱辅助先不开，可后续 ablation）。✓

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/plboa_mechanism.md:22112:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4608:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:6:触发观察/失败：现有 CR-ReID 默认 LR 是 HR crop 经一次确定性 bicubic/downsample 得到，bbox 完美、采样相位固定。但真实低分辨率里，一个人高只有 16-32 px 时，±1 个 LR 像素 bbox 偏移或 0.25/0.5 像素 sub-pixel phase 就会改变衣服条纹、鞋/腿、包带是否被采到。大家以为问题是“分辨率低，细节缺失”；其实可能是“同一个人对应一族 alias/crop-lattice 观测，模型只见过其中一个”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:8:重定义：Cross-resolution ReID = lattice-uncertain observation problem。隐藏变量不是 resolution ratio，而是采样相位、bbox 量化、downsample kernel、轻微 detector crop error。身份匹配应对这族观测做边缘化，而不是把某个确定性 LR 图当真值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:13:- 训练端做 phase-consistency / phase-adversarial augmentation，让同一 HR 图在不同 LR lattice 下保持身份稳定。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:26:撞车核查：我没查到 2024-2026 直接做 “subpixel/crop lattice uncertainty for low-resolution ReID” 的工作。VPFA 是 feature-space resolution direction，不是采样相位；LRAR 是 resolution-adaptive representation/mask；RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery 与 feature distillation；VersReID/ITKM 是多场景/CLIP 框架。这个点目前不像红海，但要继续查 “aliasing / anti-alias / bbox jitter / sub-pixel ReID”。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2307:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:53:→ lattice 边缘化是**低分辨率现象**（h≤24 强、h=32 临界、h≥48 无），正是 d_8.txt 预测的 regime。**脚本自带 AUTO VERDICT: GO（h=16/24 过全部四关：volatility ✓ / 增益≥2 ✓ / LAT-TTA>0 ✓ / phase-var|#false>0 ✓）。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2308:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:57:**机制存在（强）**：在 h=16，同一人的 LR 采样格点族确实把 frozen 特征移动 0.116（**普通 TTA 的 7.5×**），**74.9% 的 query 其 rank-1 身份随亚像素相位 / ±1 LR-pixel bbox / antialias kernel 翻转**。这正坐实 d_8.txt 的重定义："低分辨率不是模糊缺细节，而是采样格点不确定性——同一人=一族 alias 观测，模型只见过一个"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2380:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2381:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:17:① **method 件(必须有, 才是方法稿)**: 草案=phase-consistency / phase-adversarial 训练(同一 HR 图在不同 LR lattice variants 下身份特征稳定)+ 推理 K-phase marginalization。给具体 loss(consistency? adversarial? distributional?)+ 怎么训 + 它该 beat 谁(单 LR / 普通 TTA / SR-based / VPFA / LRAR / RFD)+ 训练版预期比零训练 ensemble(+4.2)强多少。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2382:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:19:③ **撞车核查(联网 2024-26)**: VPFA(feature-space resolution direction)/LRAR(resolution-adaptive representation)/RFD(multi-res gallery distillation)/VersReID/ITKM + 通用 aliasing/anti-aliasing/sub-pixel/bbox-jitter。确切 novelty 边界——'subpixel/crop-lattice sampling uncertainty as the hidden variable + marginalization'有没有被占。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2383:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:20:④ **诚实**: 能撑 CCF-B 方法稿吗(信心 1-10)? operating point 低(只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP, h=32 marginal)是不是太窄、撑不起? 怎么把'interventional ensemble 强但 correlational predictor 与 LR-severity 共线'写成干净故事不被审稿人抓(强调 marginalization 是机制不是预测)?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2384:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:23:我先做撞车核查，再把方法和协议收束成可写进论文的版本。这里关键不是证明“LR 会变差”，而是确认有没有人已经把低分辨率 ReID 明确定义成采样格点隐藏变量并做 marginalization。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2390:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:64:如果训练版 `LM-ReID + K marginalization` 能在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble 再高 **+0.8 到 +2.0 mAP**，并且 h=24 仍有稳定收益，信心到 **8/10**。如果只停留在零训练 ensemble，最多 **5/10**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:68:名字建议：**Lattice-Marginalized ReID, LM-ReID**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2392:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:72:给 HR 训练图 `x_i` 和身份 `y_i`，低分辨率观测不是单一 `LR(x_i)`，而是：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2393:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:115:`L_adv` 不要当主贡献，作为辅助去掉 embedding 中可预测的 lattice label。主贡献是 hidden lattice marginalization。adversarial 太强可能擦掉身份边缘细节，所以必须有 ablation：`marg only / marg+cons / marg+cons+adv`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2394:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:123:5. 推理默认只 marginalize LR query；如果 gallery 也 LR，再做 query-gallery 双边 marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2395:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:194:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2396:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:196:LRAR 也是强相关旧邻居。它做 resolution-adaptive representation，用动态度量、varying-length representation 和 resolution-adaptive masks 处理 HR-LR 比较。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037)) 它占了“resolution adaptive”这个词，不能用这个当 novelty。你的 novelty 应写成 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2397:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:200:VersReID 是 2024 TPAMI 方向，目标是 multi-scene ReID，低分辨率只是多个 scene 之一，用 prompt/twin modeling 解决泛化。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11121)) 它会被审稿人当大框架 baseline，但不是直接撞车。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2398:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:204:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2399:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:226:1. 低分辨率 ReID 的一部分错误不是“缺细节”造成的，而是同一 HR 身份在不同合法 LR 采样格点下落到不同 embedding 区域。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2400:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:230:5. 因此方法不是预测哪张 query 会失败，而是在所有 severe LR query 上对隐藏 lattice 做 marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2401:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:237:severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:248:如果训练版 `LM-ReID + K marginalization` 能在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble 再高 **+0.8 到 +2.0 mAP**，并且 h=24 仍有稳定收益，信心到 **8/10**。如果只停留在零训练 ensemble，最多 **5/10**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2403:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:252:名字建议：**Lattice-Marginalized ReID, LM-ReID**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2404:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:256:给 HR 训练图 `x_i` 和身份 `y_i`，低分辨率观测不是单一 `LR(x_i)`，而是：
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2405:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:299:`L_adv` 不要当主贡献，作为辅助去掉 embedding 中可预测的 lattice label。主贡献是 hidden lattice marginalization。adversarial 太强可能擦掉身份边缘细节，所以必须有 ablation：`marg only / marg+cons / marg+cons+adv`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2406:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:307:5. 推理默认只 marginalize LR query；如果 gallery 也 LR，再做 query-gallery 双边 marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2407:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:378:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2408:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:380:LRAR 也是强相关旧邻居。它做 resolution-adaptive representation，用动态度量、varying-length representation 和 resolution-adaptive masks 处理 HR-LR 比较。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037)) 它占了“resolution adaptive”这个词，不能用这个当 novelty。你的 novelty 应写成 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2409:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:384:VersReID 是 2024 TPAMI 方向，目标是 multi-scene ReID，低分辨率只是多个 scene 之一，用 prompt/twin modeling 解决泛化。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11121)) 它会被审稿人当大框架 baseline，但不是直接撞车。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2410:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:388:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2411:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:410:1. 低分辨率 ReID 的一部分错误不是“缺细节”造成的，而是同一 HR 身份在不同合法 LR 采样格点下落到不同 embedding 区域。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2412:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:414:5. 因此方法不是预测哪张 query 会失败，而是在所有 severe LR query 上对隐藏 lattice 做 marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2413:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:421:severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2556:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:7:低分辨率 ReID 失败**不是**"模糊缺细节"，而是**采样格点不确定性**：一个人在 h=16-32px 时 = 一族 alias/crop-lattice 观测（亚像素采样相位 / ±1 LR-pixel bbox 量化 / antialias kernel / 轻微 detector crop error）。模型只见过其中一个。身份匹配应对这族观测**边缘化**，而不是把某个确定性 LR 图当真值。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:2557:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:17:1. **vs 普通 TTA**：相同 K、相同融合（mean / MaxSim），但 K 个 view 是普通 test-time aug（pad+RandomCrop + hflip）of 单一 bicubic LR，**无 lattice 语义**。phase-lattice 必须明显超过普通 TTA（否则只是 TTA 换名）。MaxSim 对照尤其关键：MaxSim 取 K 中最优可能仅靠"多枪"涨点，TTA-MaxSim 同样多枪 → 差值才是 lattice 特有增益。
