experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3003:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3865:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:1268:   420	    print("[done] LM-ReID training complete. EVAL via cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py --ckpt <out>.")
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3005:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3867:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3006:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3869:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3007:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3871:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3008:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3872:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3009:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3873:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3011:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3877:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3012:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3880:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3013:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3881:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3014:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3883:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3015:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3885:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3016:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3886:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3019:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3890:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3020:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3902:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3021:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3903:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3022:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3905:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:24:也用 web search 查 lattice-marginalization / sub-pixel sampling uncertainty for low-res ReID 是否有 exact 先例。输出: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings (severity Critical/High/Medium/Low, 每条带行号+修法).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3024:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3909:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3025:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3911:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3026:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3913:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3027:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3914:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3028:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3915:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3030:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3919:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3031:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3922:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3032:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3923:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3033:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3925:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3034:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3927:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3035:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:3928:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:121:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3084:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4649:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4037:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3018:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3085:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4656:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4045:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3053:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3086:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4657:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4059:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3087:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4659:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw_v2.md:4078:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3089:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:3:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3090:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:8:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3091:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:20:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3092:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:23:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3093:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:27:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3096:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:60:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3097:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:79:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3098:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:80:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3099:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:82:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3100:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:87:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3101:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md:92:2. 实现 LM-ReID（插件式，config 开关，lattice aug 复用 `cvpb_lattice_killswitch.py` 的 LR 生成）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3103:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:11:- **High**：train/test marginalization 不对齐。训练 `sim4` 是双边 M×M LR-lattice bag-to-bag；test 是 query-LR-K变体 × gallery-HR-单图。对称训练给正样本 gallery-side oracle、给负样本 test 不存在的 gallery-side worst-pair 约束。建议非对称 `LR-query set → gallery single`，或至少加该对照。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3104:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_lsrc.md:18:没见"LR-ReID 把 sampling lattice 明确当 hidden variable 做 lattice decision marginalization"的直接先例。set contrastive/logsumexp bag score 本身不新（SupCon/MIL-NCE/set-ReID），novelty 只能落在 **sampling-lattice hidden variable + retrieval decision marginalization** 问题定义。不能声称发现 aliasing 本身（anti-aliasing 强先例）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3108:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:17:- M=1 plain(标准 CR-ReID, 单 LR/iter): single 73.62; +test-time lattice-marginalization 75.95(+2.33, beat 普通TTA +3.73)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3109:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:19:- M=3 full LM-ReID(M=3 + L_marg[marginal-likelihood -log mean_l softmax] + L_cons[consistency 拉variants特征到均值]): single **75.71**, lattice 78.04, SANITY HR 86.09
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3110:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:21:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3111:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:24:① **最强可发角度+信心1-10+CCF-B可行**: (a)重构成"lattice-aware augmentation训练 + test-time lattice marginalization, 并把consistency有害当诚实消融卖点"; (b)纯test-time lattice-marg方法; (c)换training-side机制(consistency害,别的方式用lattice先验?); (d)弃LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3112:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:26:③ 联网查: "sub-pixel/lattice augmentation for low-resolution person ReID" + "consistency/feature-alignment regularization hurts retrieval discriminability" 有先例吗? "consistency在ReID检索有害"这个负结果本身能成insight/short吗?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3150:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:2092:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_result.md:57:**机制存在（强）**：在 h=16，同一人的 LR 采样格点族确实把 frozen 特征移动 0.116（**普通 TTA 的 7.5×**），**74.9% 的 query 其 rank-1 身份随亚像素相位 / ±1 LR-pixel bbox / antialias kernel 翻转**。这正坐实 d_8.txt 的重定义："低分辨率不是模糊缺细节，而是采样格点不确定性——同一人=一族 alias 观测，模型只见过一个"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3196:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:4008:experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lattice_killswitch_DESIGN.md:7:低分辨率 ReID 失败**不是**"模糊缺细节"，而是**采样格点不确定性**：一个人在 h=16-32px 时 = 一族 alias/crop-lattice 观测（亚像素采样相位 / ±1 LR-pixel bbox 量化 / antialias kernel / 轻微 detector crop error）。模型只见过其中一个。身份匹配应对这族观测**边缘化**，而不是把某个确定性 LR 图当真值。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3231:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6395:- 判：LM-ReID single > ablation single → consistency 训练有独立价值（强 method）；≈ → 只是"LR 增强 + 测试时 lattice ensemble"（弱，test-time trick 级）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3232:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6408:- **诚实**：大头是 LR fine-tune（single 75.71 vs frozen single 42.65=+33，标准 CR-ReID，非创新）；**lattice-marg 真贡献 +2.33（robust，frozen +3.04/trained +3.006 一致 beat TTA）= 方法的 lattice-specific 贡献，但是 test-time-trick 量级**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3235:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6422:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3260:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6640:   - 对齐训练目标和 test-time lattice-MaxSim，但不加 feature consistency。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3261:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6648:我没查到明确把 **sub-pixel/bbox/kernel sampling lattice** 当作 LR-ReID hidden variable 并做 marginalization 的先例。已有 CR-ReID 主要是 SR、resolution-invariant、resolution-adaptive 或 feature-panning：LRAR 明确讲 SR / resolution-invariant 两大类，并指出纯 invariant 可能丢判别信息；VPFA 是把 resolution gap 建模成 feature direction；PS-HRNet/DIL 也仍是 restoration/invariance 框架。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3263:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6656:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3264:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6664:> Severe LR ReID 中存在 sampling-lattice uncertainty；正确策略不是把 lattice variants 强行压成同一个 embedding，而是用 lattice-aware training 增广判别性，再在检索时对 lattice hidden variable 做 marginalization。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3273:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md:6740:先跑 `M=3 ordinary-aug no-LM`。如果它明显低于 lattice-noLM，比如低 1.0 mAP 以上，LM-ReID 可以改名重投为 **Lattice-Aware Augmentation + Lattice-Marginalized Retrieval**。如果它接近 `77.44`，训练端创新就收缩，转向 pure test-time + protocol，或者上 `Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR` 抢回 training-side 主贡献。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3277:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:13:训一个 tiny crop refiner，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重采样成 canonical crop，**削弱 bbox 主因子**，剩下的 phase/kernel/残差留给 test-time K=9 decision marginalization。目标**不是**让 K 个 lattice 特征一致（那是已证伪的 consistency），是把错误 crop 校正到更可靠的 person support。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3279:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_blc.md:45:压几何偏移参数（非身份 embedding）→ 非 consistency；几何监督来自自生成 lattice（干净）→ 非弱监督瞎学；test 仍保留 K=9 marginalization → canonicalizer 只削 bbox 主因子，不替代边缘化。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3289:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:35:| **LM-ReID lattice-mean** | **72.60** | +2.63 over single（lattice-marg，**真创新**） |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3291:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:47:- 判：LM-ReID single > ablation single → consistency 训练有独立价值（强 method）；≈ → 只是"LR 增强 + 测试时 lattice ensemble"（弱，test-time trick 级）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3292:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:60:- **诚实**：大头是 LR fine-tune（single 75.71 vs frozen single 42.65=+33，标准 CR-ReID，非创新）；**lattice-marg 真贡献 +2.33（robust，frozen +3.04/trained +3.006 一致 beat TTA）= 方法的 lattice-specific 贡献，但是 test-time-trick 量级**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3295:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:74:- **★★★命门结果（2026-06-25）= 证伪 method**：no-LM-loss single **77.44 > full 75.71（+1.73）**！**consistency 训练（L_marg+L_cons）= HARMFUL 有害**，不是无用。分解：M=3 增强 +3.82（73.62→77.44，大）；consistency −1.73（77.44→75.71，过度正则压判别性）。SANITY 也证 no-LM HR 88.92 > full 86.09。**LM-ReID 作 method 死**（以 consistency 为创新，比简单 M=3 增强+测试时边缘化更差）。剩 test-time lattice-marg robust（五配置 beat TTA）但 trick（codex 5/10）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3297:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:80:salvage codex（`litreview2/lmreid_salvage.md`）：主救法 = **重构**，不卖 consistency，卖"**lattice-aware augmentation 增判别性 + test-time 对 lattice hidden variable 边缘化**（非压成同一 embedding）"。信心 6→7/10 after 命门对照，CCF-B 有条件可行。核心：no-LM-loss 77.44 已最强 = "invariance 死、lattice hidden variable + marginalization 没死"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3298:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:83:- ≈77+（=lattice no-LM）→ M=3 增益只是"更多增广"，training-side 创新缩水 → 纯 test-time。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3299:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:95:- **★不对称（干净）**：test-time lattice-marg 四配置全 beat TTA（M=1 +3.727 / ordinary-aug +1.624 / lattice no-LM +2.576 / full +3.006）→ **lattice 在 test-time 是真 hidden variable，在 training 不特殊**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3302:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:110:- ① lattice-marg **全 5 分辨率 beat 普通TTA**（robust）；② **优势随 h 单调递减**（+6.5→+0.5）= sampling-lattice 是 severe-LR nuisance 的干净证据；③ **severe LR（h=12/16）普通 TTA 反而有害**，lattice-marg 大涨 = clean contrast（防"普通 TTA"质疑）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3307:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/monitor.md:116:novelty：无 exact prior（sampling-lattice as LR-ReID hidden variable + marginalization）；BlurPool(aliasing)/FlipReID(flip consistency) 是相关先例；"consistency 有害"不单独成 paper 但强消融卖点。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3318:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:15:**LSRC 全面拉低**：训练 acc 1.000（过拟合训练集）但测试全掉 = backbone set-loss 损害判别力。marginalization 在受损 backbone 上仍 +2.288（机制工作但起点被拉低，证 lattice marg 本身没问题，是 backbone 被训坏）。**asym 不用试**（对称 M×M 给 gallery-side oracle = 宽松上界，对称都死→非对称必死）。3090 lam1.0 必死（更大权重）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3323:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:32:**train4_final codex 判决（8.5/10）：当前设定下没有值得追的 cheap 训练端机制，别硬凑。** 4 类全封：① frozen/head/sidecar 无 headroom（含 LATS）；② backbone-loss 伤判别性（consistency/LSRC）；③ robust-ERM 没赢（Hard-Lattice）；④ BLC 逻辑封住（bbox 收益来自 marginalize 非 canonicalize，market 框已 canonical）。codex 强论点：*"sampling-lattice uncertainty 不适合训练端消除/内化；强 no-LM backbone 已近最佳判别表征；有效杠杆是 test-time decision marginalization，不是 invariance/frozen-adaptation/robust-ERM/canonicalization"*。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3325:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:42:- **关键发现**：LS-MRT(+0.028)+LPA(+0.075) 两个冻结特征 probe 都 ~0 → **no-LM-loss 特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优，重投影/重加权救不了**（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen-feature 够不着）。**LCRS/LRFD/DeepSets 也是 frozen-feature 重投影，大概率同样死**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3326:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:47:| **LSRC** | 7.5/10 | full fine-tune，`L_id + lam_lsrc*(bag-to-bag set-supcon logsumexp + **neg-tail 压负样本假高 lattice**)`。打 marginalization 数学瓶颈（更少假高负例+更多可复用正证据），**解释了 frozen 为何没空间**（lattice union 已固定） | 不依赖原图 ✓ | **进行中** 4090 lam0.5 + 3090 lam1.0，acc 0.98/0.97 健康，判据 lattice mAP > 79.90 +0.3 且 single 不掉 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3328:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:57:| **LS-MRT**（set-wise 检索） | 7/10 | 把 test-time 边缘化写进**训练检索损失**：`S=logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)`，supervised contrastive over gallery。**在检索决策层边缘化非分类头**——直接修 L_marg 失败因（L_marg 在 train-ID classifier posterior 求均值→塌缩；LS-MRT 在 q-g 相似度证据边缘化，denominator 有真负 gallery） | 冻 backbone + cached K=9 features 训小 P(linear/BNNeck+τ)，**最廉价**；活=h12/16 ≥+0.3 且 K-cosine 不升 | **先跑** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3330:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_pipeline.md:65:**执行顺序**：LS-MRT 冻 probe 先（最廉价+最强故事）→ 活则全量；死则 LCRS→LRFD→LC-STN→DeepSets 逐个 cheap probe。**任何一个过线即训练端第二 contribution，凑成 train+test 完整方法（→7-8/10）。全死也不停——再启 codex 找更多。** novelty 共识：卖点不是各机制本身(decorr/disentangle/STN/DeepSets 都老)，是"**LR 采样格点当可枚举隐变量 + 训练端 X + 测试端 decision marginalization**"这个 problem reformulation + train/test 对齐。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3337:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/claude_review.md:8:- **不是小调参**：LM-ReID 是新机制（lattice-marginalized embedding），重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性；有零训练 kill-switch GO（独立轴、双 trivial 控制 vs-TTA/vs-#false 都过、GO 靠 interventional 直接测量）做前置，codex 判 CCF-B 7/10。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3339:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3348:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:45:- 低分辨率 / 跨分辨率 ReID 多数做 SR、resolution-invariant feature、resolution-adaptive mask / metric，例如 RIFE/FFSR、MRJL、LAR、RFD、VPFA。它们关注 resolution gap，不是把 bbox/phase/kernel sampling lattice 当 test-time latent variable 来训 backbone。参考：  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3349:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:57:- STN / probabilistic STN 覆盖“输入 canonicalization / transformation marginalization”这个大类，但未见低分辨率 ReID sampling-lattice latent 的直接版本。参考：  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3350:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:61:所以：**“low-res ReID = sampling-lattice latent variable，并训练 backbone 让 retrieval-time lattice marginalization 更可用”目前看有 novelty 空间**。不能声称没人做过，但比普通 SR / invariant / TTA aggregation 更像新问题定义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3353:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:98:作用很关键：marginalization 最怕某个错误 lattice 产生假高分。这个 loss 不是拉近同图多 lattice，而是压低负样本 lattice union 的尾部误匹配。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3354:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:162:可先用当前 K=9 marginalization 的 posterior 当 teacher：哪个 lattice 对真 ID / hard positive 最有利，就让 STN 学近似 canonical crop。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3356:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:214:我的判断：**当前最值得赌的是“负样本 lattice tail suppression + 正样本 top-M coverage”**。它正好打在 decision marginalization 的数学瓶颈上，也能解释为什么 frozen reweight/projection 已经没空间：旧 feature 的 lattice union 已固定，训练端必须让 backbone 产生更少假高负例、更多可复用正证据。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3365:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_backbone.md:391:我的判断：**当前最值得赌的是“负样本 lattice tail suppression + 正样本 top-M coverage”**。它正好打在 decision marginalization 的数学瓶颈上，也能解释为什么 frozen reweight/projection 已经没空间：旧 feature 的 lattice union 已固定，训练端必须让 backbone 产生更少假高负例、更多可复用正证据。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3366:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens1_align.md:14:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=对齐/规范化而非不变: 既然nuisance主要是LR bbox-crop不确定性, 训练一个模块**学着把LR crop对齐/重定心**(类spatial transformer/学到的re-centering/sub-pixel配准)让特征canonicalize而非collapse(训练降lattice spread+测试边缘化残差)。求: 具体机制(网络结构/loss/怎么和marginalization接) + 为何不重蹈invariance-collapse + 廉价kill-switch(冻结/小实验先验) + novelty(联网查STN-ReID/AlignedReID/sub-pixel-registration/spatial-alignment先例) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3373:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens1_align.md:40:短结论：**可以做，优先级高**。但主贡献不能叫“STN for ReID”，因为 STN/对齐/ReID 先例很多；应命名成 **sampling-lattice canonicalization for LR-query ReID**。核心不是“学不变性”，而是**估计 LR crop 的隐式采样格点偏移，并把输入重采样到 canonical lattice，再保留 test-time marginalization 处理残差不确定性**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3391:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:15:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3396:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:45:**BLC / LC-STN++: bbox-lattice canonical crop refiner**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3397:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:46:训练一个轻量可微 crop refiner，在图像进 Swin-Tiny 之前，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重新采样成 canonical crop；backbone 必须参与训练。test-time 仍保留 K=9 marginalization，但每个 lattice 先经过 refiner，再做特征平均或距离平均。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3398:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:69:已有工作里，STN 本身很老，原始 STN 已经是可微空间变换模块；ReID 里也有 STNReID 用 STN 做 partial ReID 对齐；person search 里也有 ReID-driven localization refinement，用 ReID loss 监督 bbox refinement。也就是说“STN/refine bbox”本身不能当新意。可争的新意是：把 **低分辨率 ReID 形式化为 sampling-lattice/bbox latent uncertainty**，训练 input canonicalizer，并和 test-time lattice marginalization 配套验证。参考：STN 原文、STNReID、ReID-driven localization refinement。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02025)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.07072)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.08580))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3399:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:75:| **1. BLC / LC-STN++ bbox canonicalizer** | bbox/crop support | 直接修正 bbox latent，降低错误背景/裁切造成的 lattice 方差，同时保留 residual marginalization | 单独不新；和 LM-ReID 的 lattice latent 绑定后有论文空间 | 10 epoch 内 K9 mAP 不涨 ≥0.4，或 bbox-jitter feature std 不降 ≥10%，或 STN 位移大量打满边界，杀 | **8/10**，若只有现成 crop 无原图/margin，降到 6.5 |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3402:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train2_input.md:94:CRReID 既有路线大量集中在 SR、multi-resolution representation、resolution-adaptive feature/mask/distillation，和你现在的“sampling-lattice latent + bbox uncertainty”不是同一个主问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1906.09748)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.12684)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037))

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3410:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:14:Review the LM-ReID fine-tuning script: the single file matching experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_*.py (exp359; design at experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design.md). 它 fine-tune frozen SOLIDER PoseBackboneModel(pose_dict=None → 纯 backbone global feat)成 lattice-marginalized embedding 抗采样格点(sub-pixel phase / +-1 LR-px bbox / antialias kernel)。请先 cat 该文件 + model/pose_backbone_model.py 的 forward。逐行审:
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3411:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:24:也用 web search 查 lattice-marginalization / sub-pixel sampling uncertainty for low-res ReID 是否有 exact 先例。输出: Verdict (approve / needs-attention) + findings (severity Critical/High/Medium/Low, 每条带行号+修法).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3413:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:32:> 后 PRCV「换问题」阶段第一个 GO 的 method 候选（9 个零训练 cheap-kill 全死后）。零训练 kill-switch 已 GO（d8 lattice, agent a68e6），method-design codex 判 **CCF-B 7/10**（训练版超 frozen ensemble → 8/10）。本实验做训练版，证明 lattice-marginalization 是 **method 不是 ensemble trick**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3414:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:37:低分辨率 ReID 的传统视角：LR = 模糊/缺细节，解法 = SR / resolution-invariant feature。**我们重定义**：一部分 LR 失败不是"缺信息"，而是 **采样格点不确定性（sampling-lattice uncertainty）**——同一个 HR 身份在不同合法的 LR 采样格点（sub-pixel phase / bbox alignment / downsample kernel）下，落到不同 embedding 区域，导致 rank-1 身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3415:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:49:两个生死控制都过：**vs 普通 TTA**（同 K 同 MaxSim，lattice 比 TTA 多 +3.04，证 lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名；lat-MaxSim 46.9 > tta 43.8 > single 42.6，无"输给 trivial baseline"问题）；**vs #false-in-topk**（phase-var partial +0.19/+0.21 存活）。机制：phase-var 是 TTA-var 的 **7.5×**；74.9% h=16 query 跨 lattice 翻转 rank-1，随 h 升单调衰减到 1.2%（h=48 机制消失 = 低分辨率专用现象）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3416:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:52:phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器**不干净**（控 LR-severity 后 partial 塌到 ≈0，与 per-image LR 失真共线）。**GO 靠的是 interventional 结果**（ensemble +4.2 / LAT−TTA +3.0 是直接测量）。故事写成 "lattice sensitivity 是 **mechanism-level nuisance**, 不是 standalone failure predictor"，方法是对所有 severe-LR query 做 marginalization（不是预测哪张失败）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3417:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:56:训练一个 lattice-marginalized embedding（对 lattice variants 身份稳定）+ 推理 K-marginalization，在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble **再高 +0.8~2.0 mAP** → 证明它学到了 lattice-invariance（是 method），不是 ensemble trick。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3420:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:89:失败最可能原因：训练版只 ≈ frozen ensemble（没学到额外 lattice-invariance）→ 沦为 test-time ensemble trick，不成方法稿。备选投稿角度：同等 mAP 下 K 从 9 降到 3 或 single inference 保留大部分收益。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3421:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:108:- **VPFA**（2510.00936，最近邻）：CR-ReID = feature-space resolution direction，Vector Panning LR→pseudo-HR。hidden variable 是 resolution gap/feature direction，**不是 sampling lattice，不做 lattice marginalization**。必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3422:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:109:- LRAR（2207.13037）：resolution-adaptive representation，占"resolution adaptive"词 → 我们 novelty 写 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3423:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:111:- BlurPool（1904.11486）：anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已老 → **不能说首次发现 aliasing 影响**。**能声称**：首次在 LR person ReID 把采样格点作隐藏变量 + rank-level intervention 证明 + lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3424:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:116:operating point 低（只在 h≤24 强 +3-4 mAP，h=32 marginal）→ 主动收窄定位 **"severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty"**，不写成通用 ReID 鲁棒性稿。h=32 marginal 反而支持机制（分辨率升高 → lattice uncertainty 消退）。真正风险 = 训练版打不过 frozen ensemble，那就只是 ensemble trick。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3442:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_raw.md:3018:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).

Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3444:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:7:- test-time decision-marginalization（对 K=9 lattice 变体边缘化检索决策）已成立（6/10），但纯 test-time。用户要训练端互补机制凑成完整方法。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3445:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:9:- **诊断**：no-LM-loss 的冻结特征对 test-time 边缘化已近最优——lattice union 固定，重投影/重加权没有 headroom（oracle +4.338 是 gallery 真 ID 上界，frozen 够不着）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3446:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:14:一句话：**训 backbone 让 K 个 lattice 变体形成"可边缘化的证据集"**——让负样本不产生假高 lattice 相似（marginalization 的数学瓶颈），让正样本有多路可匹配证据——比 frozen 重投影有空间，因为 backbone 能改变 aliasing/bbox-shift 敏感的特征本身。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3448:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/design_lsrc.md:34:- **baseline**：no-LM-loss（exp359_abl_noLMloss）= 训练端不动、只 test-time 边缘化 → lattice 79.90 / single ~76.9。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3449:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/codex_review_final.txt:34:I did not find an exact prior for “sampling-lattice hidden variable / sub-pixel phase marginalization” in low-res ReID. Closest works model resolution gap or resolution-invariant features, not lattice phase marginalization: VPFA, LRAR, RFD; BlurPool covers general anti-aliasing/shift-invariance but not ReID lattice marginalization. Sources: [VPFA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936), [LRAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037), [RFD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.07871), [BlurPool](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486).
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3466:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:14:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3469:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/train_time_options.md:22:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3473:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:13:- **因子分解（LM-S4）**: bbox 检测框 crop 不确定性主导（+2.84）> sub-pixel phase（+1.76）> zoom（+1.70）。→ mechanism = LR detector crop lattice，直观且新。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3474:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:16:1. **问题重定义** + 诊断: sampling lattice 是 LR-ReID 此前未显式建模的 test-time hidden nuisance；rank-level 干预证明它造成身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3475:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:17:2. **方法（test-time）**: 决策级 lattice marginalization（K 变体 + mean/max/logsumexp 聚合），并证明 **decision-level marginalization > training-level invariance**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3476:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:18:3. **训练端系统反例（强论点，非"没做出来"）**: 系统验证 4 类"自然但错误"的学习式替代——embedding-invariance / frozen-adaptation / robust-ERM / input-canonicalization——全部无 headroom 或伤判别力（8 机制 + 4 codex 收敛，8.5/10）→ 证 sampling-lattice 该 test-time 边缘化，不该训练端消除/内化。论点：*Learning invariance is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one.*
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3477:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:21:- **LM-S2 inference 主实验**: lattice-marg 在 h=12/16/20/24/32 **全 beat 普通 TTA**，优势随分辨率单调递减（h12 +6.5 → h32 +0.5）= sampling-lattice 是 severe-LR nuisance 的干净证据；severe LR（h12/16）普通 TTA 反而有害。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3478:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:22:- **LM-S2-strong 防御**: 用更强 TTA（pad-crop + resize-jitter + color）当 baseline，lattice 仍赢且 gap 更大（h16 LATTICE−TTA +3.337）→ 堵死"不就是多裁几次"质疑。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3480:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:24:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3483:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:42:- TTA（k-reciprocal CVPR17 进 SOTA / FlipReID / BNTA）: test-time 后处理可发先例；我们是 lattice-specific marginalization 非通用 TTA。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3484:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:44:- Alignment（STN/AlignedReID/STNReID/PAN/CDPM）: 若用 B LC-STN，卖点是"LR crop lattice 当隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3485:experiments/exp359_lm_reid/paper_skeleton.md:45:- Uncertainty（PFE/DUL/UMTS）: 若用 A LPA，卖点是 supervised sampling-lattice posterior 非 generic data-quality。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3567:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/codex_lsrc_review.md:14:独立审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 的 LSRC 训练端机制(loss_mode=='lsrc' 段, 约 line 421-443; args line 58-66)。背景: LM-ReID 把低分辨率 ReID 形式化为采样格点隐变量, test-time 对 K=9 lattice 变体做 decision marginalization(logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)); 现在加训练端 LSRC=full fine-tune backbone, loss = L_id(CE+per-slot batch-hard triplet) + lam_lsrc*(bag-to-bag set-supcon[对所有图对的 M×M lattice-pair cos 做 logsumexp 当 set score, 再 batch-softmax 拉近同 id] + lam_negtail*neg-tail[softplus 压低负样本对的 max lattice-pair cos] + lam_coverage*coverage[top-M 正样本 lattice-pair])。逐行查: (1)runtime/shape/数值 bug; (2)self-pair/对角 mask 是否正确排除; (3)train(M×M 对称 bag-to-bag) vs test(query LR K 变体 × gallery HR 单图)的 marginalization 是否够对齐, 会不会 train/test mismatch 导致训练目标跑偏; (4)和已证伪的 consistency(塌缩)/L_marg(分类头边缘化无 headroom)是否真有本质区别还是换皮; (5)联网查 set-based contrastive + lattice/sampling 当隐变量在 LR-ReID 的 novelty 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention) + findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low) + 简短中文结论。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3770:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:6:触发观察/失败：现有 CR-ReID 默认 LR 是 HR crop 经一次确定性 bicubic/downsample 得到，bbox 完美、采样相位固定。但真实低分辨率里，一个人高只有 16-32 px 时，±1 个 LR 像素 bbox 偏移或 0.25/0.5 像素 sub-pixel phase 就会改变衣服条纹、鞋/腿、包带是否被采到。大家以为问题是“分辨率低，细节缺失”；其实可能是“同一个人对应一族 alias/crop-lattice 观测，模型只见过其中一个”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3771:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:26:撞车核查：我没查到 2024-2026 直接做 “subpixel/crop lattice uncertainty for low-resolution ReID” 的工作。VPFA 是 feature-space resolution direction，不是采样相位；LRAR 是 resolution-adaptive representation/mask；RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery 与 feature distillation；VersReID/ITKM 是多场景/CLIP 框架。这个点目前不像红海，但要继续查 “aliasing / anti-alias / bbox jitter / sub-pixel ReID”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:3777:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:14:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4071:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3707:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:14:一个 ReID 团队的 **Lattice-Marginalized ReID**(重定义: 低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点不确定性, 非'模糊缺细节')零训练 kill-switch = GO。证据: frozen 模型, K=9 phase/bbox/kernel variants 的 ensemble 在 h=16 LR query 上 +4.23 mAP, **比同 K 的普通随机 TTA 多 +3.04**(lattice-specific 非 TTA 换名: lat-MaxSim 46.9>tta 43.8>single 42.6), 74.9% LR query 跨 lattice 变体翻转 rank-1 身份(h升→31%→10%), 过 vs-TTA + vs-#false 双控。**诚实: phase-var 作 per-query 失败预测器与 LR-severity 共线(correlational 弱), GO 靠 interventional ensemble 结果(直接测量)。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4072:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3708:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:17:① **method 件(必须有, 才是方法稿)**: 草案=phase-consistency / phase-adversarial 训练(同一 HR 图在不同 LR lattice variants 下身份特征稳定)+ 推理 K-phase marginalization。给具体 loss(consistency? adversarial? distributional?)+ 怎么训 + 它该 beat 谁(单 LR / 普通 TTA / SR-based / VPFA / LRAR / RFD)+ 训练版预期比零训练 ensemble(+4.2)强多少。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4081:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3719:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:68:名字建议：**Lattice-Marginalized ReID, LM-ReID**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4082:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3723:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:115:`L_adv` 不要当主贡献，作为辅助去掉 embedding 中可预测的 lattice label。主贡献是 hidden lattice marginalization。adversarial 太强可能擦掉身份边缘细节，所以必须有 ablation：`marg only / marg+cons / marg+cons+adv`。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4083:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3726:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:123:5. 推理默认只 marginalize LR query；如果 gallery 也 LR，再做 query-gallery 双边 marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4084:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3735:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:194:VPFA 是最近最接近的强邻居。它把 CR-ReID 看成 feature space 中的 resolution direction，并用 Vector Panning 模块把 LR feature 映射到 pseudo-HR feature；论文还强调 SR 和 resolution-invariant 方法的瓶颈。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936)) 但它的 hidden variable 是“resolution gap / feature direction”，不是 sub-pixel sampling lattice，也不是对 lattice variants 做 marginalization。边界清楚，但必须正面对比。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4085:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3736:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:196:LRAR 也是强相关旧邻居。它做 resolution-adaptive representation，用动态度量、varying-length representation 和 resolution-adaptive masks 处理 HR-LR 比较。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037)) 它占了“resolution adaptive”这个词，不能用这个当 novelty。你的 novelty 应写成 sampling-lattice uncertainty。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4086:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3739:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:204:通用 anti-aliasing/shift-invariance 已经很老，BlurPool 明确指出小输入平移会导致 CNN 输出大变，downsampling 忽略 sampling theorem，低通 anti-alias 可改善鲁棒性。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.11486?utm_source=openai)) 所以不能声称“首次发现 aliasing/phase 影响深度模型”。能声称的是：**首次在 LR person ReID 中把采样格点作为隐藏变量，用 rank-level intervention 证明其影响，并用 lattice-specific marginalization 解决检索身份翻转。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4087:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3744:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:230:5. 因此方法不是预测哪张 query 会失败，而是在所有 severe LR query 上对隐藏 lattice 做 marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4088:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3745:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:237:severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4089:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3748:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:248:如果训练版 `LM-ReID + K marginalization` 能在 h=16 上比 frozen lattice ensemble 再高 **+0.8 到 +2.0 mAP**，并且 h=24 仍有稳定收益，信心到 **8/10**。如果只停留在零训练 ensemble，最多 **5/10**。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4097:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:3775:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lattice_method_design.md:421:severe low-resolution / cross-resolution ReID under sampling-lattice uncertainty
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4410:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5075:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:6:触发观察/失败：现有 CR-ReID 默认 LR 是 HR crop 经一次确定性 bicubic/downsample 得到，bbox 完美、采样相位固定。但真实低分辨率里，一个人高只有 16-32 px 时，±1 个 LR 像素 bbox 偏移或 0.25/0.5 像素 sub-pixel phase 就会改变衣服条纹、鞋/腿、包带是否被采到。大家以为问题是“分辨率低，细节缺失”；其实可能是“同一个人对应一族 alias/crop-lattice 观测，模型只见过其中一个”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4411:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5079:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/explore20/clean/d_8.txt:26:撞车核查：我没查到 2024-2026 直接做 “subpixel/crop lattice uncertainty for low-resolution ReID” 的工作。VPFA 是 feature-space resolution direction，不是采样相位；LRAR 是 resolution-adaptive representation/mask；RFD 处理 multi-resolution gallery 与 feature distillation；VersReID/ITKM 是多场景/CLIP 框架。这个点目前不像红海，但要继续查 “aliasing / anti-alias / bbox jitter / sub-pixel ReID”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4413:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5164:仓库里已有一批 LM-ReID/第四类训练机制的探索记录，我先把这些读完，避免给出已经被本地实验证伪的“新建议”。重点看 `lmreid_salvage`、`train3_fourthclass`、`train2_*` 和 lattice 结果。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4415:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5188:- M=1 plain(标准 CR-ReID, 单 LR/iter): single 73.62; +test-time lattice-marginalization 75.95(+2.33, beat 普通TTA +3.73)
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4416:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5190:- M=3 full LM-ReID(M=3 + L_marg[marginal-likelihood -log mean_l softmax] + L_cons[consistency 拉variants特征到均值]): single **75.71**, lattice 78.04, SANITY HR 86.09
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4417:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5192:关键发现: ①M=3 lattice-augmentation 大涨 +3.82(M=1→no-LM); ②**consistency训练(L_marg+L_cons) HARMFUL −1.73(no-LM→full)还掉HR(88.92→86.09)** = 过度正则压判别性; ③test-time lattice marginalization 真robust(M=1/no-LM/full/frozen 全配置 beat TTA +2.5~3.7)但纯test-time(早先codex判5/10)。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4418:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5195:① **最强可发角度+信心1-10+CCF-B可行**: (a)重构成"lattice-aware augmentation训练 + test-time lattice marginalization, 并把consistency有害当诚实消融卖点"; (b)纯test-time lattice-marg方法; (c)换training-side机制(consistency害,别的方式用lattice先验?); (d)弃LM-ReID。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4419:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5197:③ 联网查: "sub-pixel/lattice augmentation for low-resolution person ReID" + "consistency/feature-alignment regularization hurts retrieval discriminability" 有先例吗? "consistency在ReID检索有害"这个负结果本身能成insight/short吗?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4422:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5427:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=backbone训练目标: 什么loss训backbone(非冻结)让K个lattice变体的特征对decision marginalization更友好(union更富/更互补/残差更可分), 但不塌缩不掉单变体判别? 和已死的consistency/L_marg/Hard-Lattice本质区别在哪? 怎么用unfreeze-last-block小实验廉价验?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4431:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5458:- 低分辨率 / 跨分辨率 ReID 多数做 SR、resolution-invariant feature、resolution-adaptive mask / metric，例如 RIFE/FFSR、MRJL、LAR、RFD、VPFA。它们关注 resolution gap，不是把 bbox/phase/kernel sampling lattice 当 test-time latent variable 来训 backbone。参考：  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4432:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5470:- STN / probabilistic STN 覆盖“输入 canonicalization / transformation marginalization”这个大类，但未见低分辨率 ReID sampling-lattice latent 的直接版本。参考：  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4433:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5474:所以：**“low-res ReID = sampling-lattice latent variable，并训练 backbone 让 retrieval-time lattice marginalization 更可用”目前看有 novelty 空间**。不能声称没人做过，但比普通 SR / invariant / TTA aggregation 更像新问题定义。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4436:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5511:作用很关键：marginalization 最怕某个错误 lattice 产生假高分。这个 loss 不是拉近同图多 lattice，而是压低负样本 lattice union 的尾部误匹配。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4437:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5575:可先用当前 K=9 marginalization 的 posterior 当 teacher：哪个 lattice 对真 ID / hard positive 最有利，就让 STN 学近似 canonical crop。  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4439:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5627:我的判断：**当前最值得赌的是“负样本 lattice tail suppression + 正样本 top-M coverage”**。它正好打在 decision marginalization 的数学瓶颈上，也能解释为什么 frozen reweight/projection 已经没空间：旧 feature 的 lattice union 已固定，训练端必须让 backbone 产生更少假高负例、更多可复用正证据。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4443:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5689:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=第四类训练端机制: 除了(frozen重投影/backbone-set-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize)这四类, 还有什么本质不同的训练端机制能真正提升lattice marginalization且不损害判别力? 特别想: 是否可以只训练一个轻量ADAPTER/side-branch(不动主backbone避免损害判别力, 但又不是frozen重投影那种无空间)? 或data-side(只改训练数据采样不改loss)? 给具体机制+为何不会重蹈LSRC损害判别力+廉价kill-switch+联网novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4445:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5954:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time lattice marginalization成立6/10(K=9变体[phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/kernel]边缘化, 5分辨率全beat普通TTA, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**关键新发现(实测): 所有冻backbone的frozen-feature训练端probe都失败**: LS-MRT重投影linear P +0.028; LPA query-side加权 +0.075; LPA-oracle headroom +4.338但=gallery真ID上界(query/frozen-feature够不着)。**结论: no-LM-loss冻结特征对test-time marginalization已近最优, 重投影/重加权救不了。训练端价值必须来自(a)改变特征本身=backbone训练 或(b)改变输入=如LC-STN canonicalization重采样crop**。已死: consistency塌缩/L_marg有害/lattice-aug不特殊/Hard-Lattice ERM死/LPA死/LS-MRT-frozen死。求训练端机制FUNDAMENTALLY改特征或输入(非frozen-feature tweak)让marginalization涨更多, 避开invariance-collapse, 廉价kill-switch。给具体机制+为何能改善(不是又一个frozen重投影)+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=改输入(input-level): LC-STN重采样canonical crop是一种; 还有什么训练端input-level机制(learned下采样核/anti-alias/可微bbox refine/sampling-aware augmentation生成)改变进backbone的图, 让marginalization残差更小或更有信息? 哪个最贴bbox检测框主导这个发现? kill-switch?
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4450:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5984:**BLC / LC-STN++: bbox-lattice canonical crop refiner**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4451:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:5985:训练一个轻量可微 crop refiner，在图像进 Swin-Tiny 之前，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重新采样成 canonical crop；backbone 必须参与训练。test-time 仍保留 K=9 marginalization，但每个 lattice 先经过 refiner，再做特征平均或距离平均。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4452:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6008:已有工作里，STN 本身很老，原始 STN 已经是可微空间变换模块；ReID 里也有 STNReID 用 STN 做 partial ReID 对齐；person search 里也有 ReID-driven localization refinement，用 ReID loss 监督 bbox refinement。也就是说“STN/refine bbox”本身不能当新意。可争的新意是：把 **低分辨率 ReID 形式化为 sampling-lattice/bbox latent uncertainty**，训练 input canonicalizer，并和 test-time lattice marginalization 配套验证。参考：STN 原文、STNReID、ReID-driven localization refinement。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02025)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.07072)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.08580))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4453:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6014:| **1. BLC / LC-STN++ bbox canonicalizer** | bbox/crop support | 直接修正 bbox latent，降低错误背景/裁切造成的 lattice 方差，同时保留 residual marginalization | 单独不新；和 LM-ReID 的 lattice latent 绑定后有论文空间 | 10 epoch 内 K9 mAP 不涨 ≥0.4，或 bbox-jitter feature std 不降 ≥10%，或 STN 位移大量打满边界，杀 | **8/10**，若只有现成 crop 无原图/margin，降到 6.5 |

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4457:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6040:**BLC / LC-STN++: bbox-lattice canonical crop refiner**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4458:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6041:训练一个轻量可微 crop refiner，在图像进 Swin-Tiny 之前，把带 bbox/phase 扰动的 crop 重新采样成 canonical crop；backbone 必须参与训练。test-time 仍保留 K=9 marginalization，但每个 lattice 先经过 refiner，再做特征平均或距离平均。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4459:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6064:已有工作里，STN 本身很老，原始 STN 已经是可微空间变换模块；ReID 里也有 STNReID 用 STN 做 partial ReID 对齐；person search 里也有 ReID-driven localization refinement，用 ReID loss 监督 bbox refinement。也就是说“STN/refine bbox”本身不能当新意。可争的新意是：把 **低分辨率 ReID 形式化为 sampling-lattice/bbox latent uncertainty**，训练 input canonicalizer，并和 test-time lattice marginalization 配套验证。参考：STN 原文、STNReID、ReID-driven localization refinement。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02025)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.07072)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.08580))

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4466:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6121:独立审查 experiments/cargo_cvpb/cvpb_lm_reid_train.py 的 LSRC 训练端机制(loss_mode=='lsrc' 段, 约 line 421-443; args line 58-66)。背景: LM-ReID 把低分辨率 ReID 形式化为采样格点隐变量, test-time 对 K=9 lattice 变体做 decision marginalization(logmeanexp_k sim(z_q,k, z_g)); 现在加训练端 LSRC=full fine-tune backbone, loss = L_id(CE+per-slot batch-hard triplet) + lam_lsrc*(bag-to-bag set-supcon[对所有图对的 M×M lattice-pair cos 做 logsumexp 当 set score, 再 batch-softmax 拉近同 id] + lam_negtail*neg-tail[softplus 压低负样本对的 max lattice-pair cos] + lam_coverage*coverage[top-M 正样本 lattice-pair])。逐行查: (1)runtime/shape/数值 bug; (2)self-pair/对角 mask 是否正确排除; (3)train(M×M 对称 bag-to-bag) vs test(query LR K 变体 × gallery HR 单图)的 marginalization 是否够对齐, 会不会 train/test mismatch 导致训练目标跑偏; (4)和已证伪的 consistency(塌缩)/L_marg(分类头边缘化无 headroom)是否真有本质区别还是换皮; (5)联网查 set-based contrastive + lattice/sampling 当隐变量在 LR-ReID 的 novelty 先例。输出 Verdict(approve/needs-attention) + findings(severity Critical/High/Medium/Low) + 简短中文结论。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4471:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6387:ReID 团队 LM-ReID(重定义低分辨率 ReID = 采样格点 sampling-lattice hidden variable, 非模糊)方法稿 salvage 命门对照出了, 求下一步定夺。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4475:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6401:② 剩三路哪条最值: (b)纯 test-time lattice-marg 方法(robust, 你先前判4.5/10) / (c)Hard-Lattice ERM[L=mean_l L_id(l)+gamma·logsumexp_l L_id(l)/tau, 优化最难 lattice variant](命门说 lattice 训练不特殊→被削弱? 还是因 test-time lattice 特殊, 训练 handle 最难 variant 仍可能帮?) / (d)弃 LM-ReID。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4485:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6436:初步查到的形势：ReID 里 test-time 不是禁区，k-reciprocal re-ranking 这种纯后处理曾进 CVPR；TTA/flip TTA 也有专门论文讨论训练-推理 gap。但“sampling lattice / aliasing”在 ReID 里没搜到直接成熟路线，更多是通用视觉里的 shift/aliasing 先例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4486:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6440:总判：**砍掉“训练端 lattice 是核心创新”的故事，但不要立刻弃 LM-ReID。把稿子改救成“severe LR ReID 中 sampling lattice 是 test-time hidden nuisance，正确处理是 retrieval/decision-level marginalization，而不是训练端 embedding invariance”。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4487:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6443:ReID 里 test-time/post-processing 不是不能发：k-reciprocal re-ranking 是无监督后处理并进了 CVPR 2017；FlipReID 明确讨论 ReID TTA 和训练-推理 gap；BNTA 也是 ReID test-time adaptation。通用视觉里，shift/aliasing/sub-pixel sensitivity 有 ICML/CVPR 先例。但我快速查了 “anti-aliasing / sampling lattice / subpixel / cross-resolution + person ReID”，没看到直接把 sampling lattice 当 LR-ReID hidden variable 的成熟先例。这个空位可用，但要讲窄、讲硬。来源：k-reciprocal ReID re-ranking、FlipReID、BNTA、anti-aliased CNN、fractional shift alias-free CNN、CR-ReID resolution-adaptive prior。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4488:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6450:但 Verdict 不是“lattice 现象不存在”。更准确是：**h=16 的 +0.54 只能作为 diagnostic signal，不能当主贡献。信心 7/10。** 它支持“低分辨率下 lattice 有影响”，不支持“训练端 lattice augmentation 是方法命门”。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4489:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6455:`(b) 纯 test-time lattice marginalization`：**最值。信心 7.5/10；论文潜力 6/10。**  
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4490:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6456:你的关键证据是四配置全 beat 普通 TTA，而且 ordinary-aug 模型也涨 `+1.624`。这说明收益不是“训练时见过 lattice”，而是 inference 时确实有 latent sampling choice。它比原 LM-ReID 更容易讲干净，但必须避免被审稿人看成普通 TTA。核心对照必须是 equal-cost ordinary TTA、多 crop/flip/resize/color TTA、feature-mean vs distance/score marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4492:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6462:如果后续 test-time lattice 对 ordinary TTA 的优势在多 seed/多数据集上消失，再弃。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4493:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6469:> Sampling lattice is a nuisance variable in severe LR ReID, but forcing embedding-level invariance is not the right treatment. Because aliasing may change identity evidence, training-time consistency collapses useful but unstable cues; retrieval-time marginalization preserves alternatives and integrates them at decision level.

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4514:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6571:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(同图K=9 lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox检测框/antialias kernel]边缘化, Market h12-32全beat普通TTA优势随分辨率递减, bbox检测框crop不确定性主导+2.84)。用户要更强训练端互补机制(train+test结合6/10→7-8/10), **明确不许止步test-time-only**。**训练端已死/将死(别重复)**: ①consistency拉变体特征到均值=collapse压判别性-1.73还掉HR; ②marginal-likelihood L_marg=训练有害大元凶; ③lattice-aug训练≈普通random增广+0.54不lattice-specific; ④LPA query-side加权头FAIL(最佳变体query+gallery共定单看query预测不出来acc≈chance 12%); ⑤Hard-Lattice ERM大概率负。**铁律: 训练端invariance/feature-collapse死; query-side预测最佳变体死**。LIVE备选=LC-STN canonicalization(估计+重采样对齐LR crop监督几何非身份)。求新训练端机制和test-time marginalization互补, 避开上述死法, 廉价kill-switch(优先冻backbone probe)。给具体机制+为何不重蹈死法+kill-switch+联网查novelty+信心1-10, 务实中文。 ★lens=让K个变体特征更**互补complementary**而非塌缩(失败consistency的反面): 训练push变体捕捉不同身份证据(structured diversity/decorrelation/子空间分配/orthogonality), 让test-time边缘化(union)信息更富。为何不退化成噪声?

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4519:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6606:其中 `P_shared` 学所有变体共有身份证据，`P_k` 或 factorized `P_phase / P_bbox / P_kernel` 学 lattice-specific 残差子空间。测试仍然用现在已成立的 K=9 decision marginalization，不预测最佳 variant。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4523:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6653:查到的边界是：CR-ReID 现有主流仍多围绕 SR、resolution-invariant 或 resolution-adaptive feature。LRR 明确指出 resolution-invariant 可能丢判别信息，这和你们 consistency collapse 的经验一致。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037))  但“diversity/orthogonality 在 ReID 里”本身不新，ABD-Net 已经做过 attention/activation/weight orthogonality，D2FEL 也做 diverse feature self-ensemble。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.01114?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08460))  2026 版本 VPFA 是 post-hoc resolution feature alignment，也不是 sampling-lattice marginalization 训练。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936))
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4524:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6657:> 把 LR-ReID 的采样格点不确定性显式建成 latent lattice，并训练 lattice-conditioned complementary evidence，使 test-time decision marginalization 得到更丰富的 union evidence。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4525:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6680:其中 `P_shared` 学所有变体共有身份证据，`P_k` 或 factorized `P_phase / P_bbox / P_kernel` 学 lattice-specific 残差子空间。测试仍然用现在已成立的 K=9 decision marginalization，不预测最佳 variant。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4529:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6727:查到的边界是：CR-ReID 现有主流仍多围绕 SR、resolution-invariant 或 resolution-adaptive feature。LRR 明确指出 resolution-invariant 可能丢判别信息，这和你们 consistency collapse 的经验一致。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.13037))  但“diversity/orthogonality 在 ReID 里”本身不新，ABD-Net 已经做过 attention/activation/weight orthogonality，D2FEL 也做 diverse feature self-ensemble。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.01114?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.08460))  2026 版本 VPFA 是 post-hoc resolution feature alignment，也不是 sampling-lattice marginalization 训练。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.00936))

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4537:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6846:| 1 | **LATS: Lattice-Aware Token Sidecar** | 冻结主 backbone，读取 stage2/3 token map，训练小 side-branch 输出 bounded residual：`z_k=norm(z0_k + α r_k)`，test 仍 K9 marginalization | 不改主干，不做 bag set-loss，不拉 K 个特征一致；`α=0` 可退回 no-LM baseline；比 LS-MRT 多了空间 token 信息，不是 final embedding 线性 P | 缓存 token 训 5-10 epoch；若 K9 mAP < +0.3、HR sanity 掉 >0.3、single 掉 >0.5、最优 α≈0，杀 | **6.5/10** |
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4540:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train3_fourthclass.md:6876:如果 LATS 也只能 +0.0~0.2，那基本说明：**训练端在当前数据和 backbone 上没有可用 headroom**。这时别继续堆 adapter/diversity，转回把论文写成 test-time lattice marginalization + 训练端失败规律，或者去做 BLC/LC-STN 这种 input support 机制。

experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4546:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:15:ReID团队 LM-ReID(低分辨率person ReID 重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量,非模糊): test-time decision-marginalization已成立(LR-query vs HR-gallery, 同图K=9个lattice变体[sub-pixel phase/±1 LR-pixel bbox/antialias kernel]做边缘化, Market h=12/16/20/24/32全beat普通TTA, 优势随分辨率单调递减h12 +6.5→h32 +0.5; 因子分解=**bbox检测框±1 LR-pixel的crop不确定性主导+2.84** > phase +1.76 > zoom +1.70)。**训练端已试全负**: ①consistency(拉K变体特征到均值)有害single -1.73还掉HR sanity; ②lattice-aug(训练时见lattice变体)≈普通random增广只差+0.54不lattice-specific; ③marginal-likelihood L_marg是训练有害大元凶。**铁律: 训练端做invariance/feature-collapse压判别性=死路**。目标=一个**互补的训练端创新**和test-time marginalization结合成train+test完整方法(更有把握, 6/10→7-8/10)。 ★lens=表达不确定性而非压掉: 训练模型**输出lattice诱导的不确定性**(per-sample spread/方差/置信), 把test-time的K-marginalization部分amortize进一个学到的不确定性头, 测试时用它加权/校准retrieval。求: 具体机制(heteroscedastic回归? lattice-variance head? 怎么监督?) + 为何不collapse + 廉价kill-switch + novelty(联网查uncertainty-ReID/PFE-probabilistic-embedding/DUL-data-uncertainty先例, ★必须说清怎么不撞PFE) + 信心1-10 + 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4555:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:973:web search: low resolution person re-identification uncertainty test time augmentation marginalization lattice sub-pixel crop
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4556:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:983:**结论先说**：我不建议主打普通 `heteroscedastic embedding NLL`。更稳的是做 **Lattice Uncertainty Distillation, LUD**：主 ReID embedding 完全按原 baseline 训练；额外训练一个只预测 lattice 风险的头，测试时用它给 K 个 lattice hypothesis 做加权 marginalization。信心：**7/10**。如果想完全用 head 替代 K 次测试，信心降到 **5/10**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4557:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:1019:用 ANOVA/分组方差监督。你已经知道 bbox crop 不确定性最大，这个 head 正好把 story 讲实：模型不是泛泛估计“图像质量”，而是在估计 sampling-lattice 里的哪类不确定性主导。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4562:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:1080:**不是 generic probabilistic embedding，也不是 data-quality uncertainty。是 supervised sampling-lattice uncertainty：不确定性来源是明确定义的 LR sampling lattice latent variable，并且监督来自同一图像 K 个 lattice hypothesis 的 empirical decision spread。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4564:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:1085:**结论先说**：我不建议主打普通 `heteroscedastic embedding NLL`。更稳的是做 **Lattice Uncertainty Distillation, LUD**：主 ReID embedding 完全按原 baseline 训练；额外训练一个只预测 lattice 风险的头，测试时用它给 K 个 lattice hypothesis 做加权 marginalization。信心：**7/10**。如果想完全用 head 替代 K 次测试，信心降到 **5/10**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4565:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:1121:用 ANOVA/分组方差监督。你已经知道 bbox crop 不确定性最大，这个 head 正好把 story 讲实：模型不是泛泛估计“图像质量”，而是在估计 sampling-lattice 里的哪类不确定性主导。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4570:experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/train_lens2_uncertainty.md:1182:**不是 generic probabilistic embedding，也不是 data-quality uncertainty。是 supervised sampling-lattice uncertainty：不确定性来源是明确定义的 LR sampling lattice latent variable，并且监督来自同一图像 K 个 lattice hypothesis 的 empirical decision spread。**
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4589:训练端做 invariance / feature-collapse 压判别性 = 死路：consistency −1.73、lattice-aug 不特殊 +0.54、L_marg 训练有害大元凶。新机制必须绕开"逼 K 变体特征塌成一个点"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4593:- **LUD（Lattice Uncertainty Distillation，lens2）= 同族**：训头预测 lattice 风险 risk_k（stopgrad teacher 的 spread + margin），测试 per-variant 加权。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4597:- **不撞 PFE**：PFE=generic data-quality uncertainty；LPA=supervised sampling-lattice posterior（隐变量来源明确 = LR 采样格点，监督来自 K-hypothesis empirical spread）。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4605:- **novelty**：STN/AlignedReID/PAN/STNReID/CDPM 先例多 → 卖点不是"用 STN"，是"LR detector crop lattice 当可边缘化隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 decision marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4608:- raw Hard-Lattice ERM/CVaR（太像更狠 lattice-aug，续压判别性）→ 只做 cheap ablation（= 正在跑的 LM-S5，验证后即停）
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4629:- **因子分解（LM-S4）**: bbox 检测框 crop 不确定性主导（+2.84）> sub-pixel phase（+1.76）> zoom（+1.70）。→ mechanism = LR detector crop lattice，直观且新。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4632:1. **问题重定义** + 诊断: sampling lattice 是 LR-ReID 此前未显式建模的 test-time hidden nuisance；rank-level 干预证明它造成身份翻转。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4633:2. **方法（test-time）**: 决策级 lattice marginalization（K 变体 + mean/max/logsumexp 聚合），并证明 **decision-level marginalization > training-level invariance**。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4634:3. **训练端系统反例（强论点，非"没做出来"）**: 系统验证 4 类"自然但错误"的学习式替代——embedding-invariance / frozen-adaptation / robust-ERM / input-canonicalization——全部无 headroom 或伤判别力（8 机制 + 4 codex 收敛，8.5/10）→ 证 sampling-lattice 该 test-time 边缘化，不该训练端消除/内化。论点：*Learning invariance is the wrong objective; marginalizing decisions over plausible observations is the right one.*
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4637:- **LM-S2 inference 主实验**: lattice-marg 在 h=12/16/20/24/32 **全 beat 普通 TTA**，优势随分辨率单调递减（h12 +6.5 → h32 +0.5）= sampling-lattice 是 severe-LR nuisance 的干净证据；severe LR（h12/16）普通 TTA 反而有害。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4638:- **LM-S2-strong 防御**: 用更强 TTA（pad-crop + resize-jitter + color）当 baseline，lattice 仍赢且 gap 更大（h16 LATTICE−TTA +3.337）→ 堵死"不就是多裁几次"质疑。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4640:- **训练端反例（强消融卖点）**: consistency 拉特征到均值有害（−1.73 还掉 HR sanity）；lattice-aug 训练 ≈ 普通 random 增广（只 +0.54 不 lattice-specific，命门对照）；marginal-likelihood L_marg 是训练有害大元凶（cons-only 诊断）。→ 坐实"训练端 invariance/collapse 压判别性"，反衬 test-time marginalization。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4646:2. **frozen adaptation no headroom**: LS-MRT +0.028 / LPA +0.075。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4647:3. **backbone set/robust training damages base**: LSRC HR 88.92→85.84 / lattice 79.90→77.98，Hard-Lattice 76.9 < 77.44，train acc 1.0 但 test 掉。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4658:- TTA（k-reciprocal CVPR17 进 SOTA / FlipReID / BNTA）: test-time 后处理可发先例；我们是 lattice-specific marginalization 非通用 TTA。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4659:- Aliasing（BlurPool）: shift-variance 已知，但我们不是"发现 aliasing"，是"把 sampling lattice 当可边缘化隐变量"。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4660:- Alignment（STN/AlignedReID/STNReID/PAN/CDPM）: 若用 B LC-STN，卖点是"LR crop lattice 当隐变量 + 监督 canonicalization 非 invariance + 残差 marginalization"组合无先例。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4661:- Uncertainty（PFE/DUL/UMTS）: 若用 A LPA，卖点是 supervised sampling-lattice posterior 非 generic data-quality。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:4683:LM-ReID test-time decision marginalization(低分辨率ReID重定义为采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test时对K=9变体[phase/bbox/kernel]做决策级边缘化)已成立: LM-S2 5分辨率全beat普通TTA / LM-S2-strong全beat强TTA(+0.76~7.28, severe LR处强TTA本身有害) / LM-S4 bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84 / K-sweep K=5达87%收益 / LM-S3聚合(logsumexp soft-marginalization在severe LR最优) / backbone泛化(Swin +7.01证不依赖SOLIDER)。**训练端定论穷尽(8机制实测+4codex 8.5/10判无空间, frozen/backbone-loss/robust-ERM/input-canonicalize全死或证伪)**。paperstrategy判test-time+训练端反例 **6.5/10天花板**(BLC证伪→够不到7.5, 易被打成strong-TTA/ensemble)。**问: 这个工作有没有test-time或问题重定义的新角度能冲7+? 候选方向: (a)marginalization之外的test-time机制(reliability/选择性/conformal)? (b)新评测协议或问题设定让贡献更硬? (c)和相邻问题(video/multi-shot/tracklet/cross-resolution retrieval)结合? (d)6.5确实天花板该收尾投B类workshop/会议? 诚实评估别硬凑, 哪个最可能+为什么+kill-switch+信心1-10。** 务实中文。
experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/lmreid_push7.md:5045:ReID LM-ReID(低分辨率ReID=采样格点sampling-lattice隐变量, test-time decision marginalization 对K=9变体边缘化已成立6/10, bbox检测框不确定性主导+2.84)。**训练端三类机制实测全死**: (1)frozen-feature重投影/重加权(LS-MRT set-retrieval linear P +0.028, LPA query加权+0.075)——no-LM-loss冻结特征对边缘化已最优无headroom; (2)backbone set-loss(LSRC=bag-to-bag set-supcon+neg-tail full fine-tune)死——HR sanity 88.92→85.84掉3点, LR h16 lattice 79.90→77.98掉2点, 训练acc1.000但测试全掉=损害判别力/过拟合训练集; (3)Hard-Lattice ERM死(76.9<77.44)。marginalization在受损backbone上仍+2.288(机制工作但起点被拉低)。强烈暗示no-LM-loss backbone已是LR-ReID好特征, 训练端干预要么无用(frozen)要么有害(改backbone)。备选BLC(input canonicalize bbox crop)未验但market只裁好框受限6.5。 ★lens=诚实评估+论文策略: 三类训练端全死, 是否说明这个问题训练端根本没空间(no-LM-loss已最优, 边缘化是唯一杠杆)? 如果是, 怎么把训练端系统性失败(invariance塌缩/L_marg有害/set-loss损害判别力/frozen无空间)写成论文的强论点(反衬test-time marginalization必要性), 而不是显得我们训练端没做出来? 这样的test-time-only+训练端反例稿能投B类吗? 给论文叙事结构+信心1-10, 务实中文。
